reply_text:
I answered Dana in her DM: her cutoff for the Brackenwater Freight Co. paperwork on the Juniper renewal is **26 September**.

That date comes from Dana herself. She sent it to me in a DM on 14 October and asked me to remember it from then on. The brain saved it, and only she can see it. I found nothing newer that changes it. The brain search was keyword-only, so a correction worded differently could have been missed.

Since 26 September had already passed by 17 October, I told her it applies to the next cycle and asked her to tell me if she meant a different date for this round. I used only her DM and her own saved messages, and nothing was shared anywhere else.
